description: Contextual meaning distinctions, not a closed vocabulary or automatic replacement list.

entries.sense: Can express a requirement or a strong inference.
entries.caution: Identify which meaning is intended before paraphrasing.
entries.example: The light is on; someone must be inside.

entries.sense: In a directive, prohibits an action.
entries.caution: Do not replace it with absence of necessity.
entries.example: You must not share this key.

entries.sense: States that an action is not required.
entries.caution: It is not a prohibition. Absence of this requirement alone does not establish all other permissions.
entries.example: You do not have to print the form.

entries.sense: Can give advice or express an expectation.
entries.caution: Do not strengthen it to must or will without evidence.
entries.example: The job should finish soon, but its status is unknown.

entries.sense: Can give permission or mark possibility.
entries.caution: May not can be ambiguous between prohibition and possible non-occurrence.
entries.example: The archive may not be ready yet.

entries.sense: Can express capability, permission or general possibility.
entries.caution: Cannot may reflect a technical limit or a rule; specify the distinction only when known.
entries.example: Editors can rename files.

entries.sense: Introduces a necessary condition.
entries.caution: Does not, by itself, guarantee the result when the condition holds.
entries.example: Release the file only if the owner approves.

entries.sense: Introduces an exception condition in the relevant construction.
entries.caution: Do not infer the converse or replace every if not; context and speech uses matter.
entries.example: Keep the draft unless the owner asks you to delete it.

entries.sense: Marks a time boundary.
entries.caution: A prohibition until an event does not guarantee the event will occur or require the action afterward.
entries.example: Do not submit until the check finishes.

entries.sense: Negates the whole-set claim.
entries.caution: It does not mean none and does not guarantee that any item meets the predicate.
entries.example: Not all four tasks finished.

entries.sense: Zero members in the relevant group satisfy the predicate.
entries.caution: State the group; missing observations are not evidence of zero.
entries.example: None of the four tasks finished.

entries.sense: Sets an inclusive upper bound.
entries.caution: Fewer than excludes the endpoint and is not equivalent.
entries.example: Attach at most 10 files.

entries.sense: For a count, sets a strict upper bound.
entries.caution: Preserve the endpoint even when a shorter phrase sounds smoother.
entries.example: Attach fewer than 10 files.

entries.sense: Sets an inclusive lower bound.
entries.caution: More than is strict; do not exchange them.
entries.example: Keep at least two copies.

entries.sense: Names an absolute difference between percentages.
entries.caution: A change from 10% to 15% is five percentage points and a 50% relative increase.
entries.example: The share rose by five percentage points.

entries.sense: Connects alternatives; whether both are allowed depends on context.
entries.caution: If the choice affects behavior, make inclusive or exclusive scope explicit from confirmed requirements.
entries.example: Select email, SMS, or both.

entries.sense: Check or establish something against evidence, depending on context.
entries.caution: Checked does not necessarily mean passed; name the criterion and outcome when known.
entries.example: We checked the signature; it did not match.

entries.sense: Assess against stated requirements or an intended use, depending on the field.
entries.caution: Do not treat it as a universal synonym for tested, true, certified or production-ready.
entries.example: The parser accepted the JSON syntax.

entries.sense: Information is missing or not established.
entries.caution: It is not a synonym for zero, false, failed or unavailable.
entries.example: The delivery status is unknown.

entries.sense: A test was performed.
entries.caution: The word alone does not identify coverage, environment or success.
entries.example: The export was tested locally; production was not tested.

entries.sense: Waiting for processing in the described workflow.
entries.caution: Do not relabel it sent, delivered or completed without an event proving that transition.
entries.example: Your export is queued.

entries.sense: Dispatched in the specified system.
entries.caution: It does not, by itself, establish delivery, reading or acceptance.
entries.example: The email was sent.

entries.sense: Reached a defined delivery endpoint.
entries.caution: Name or verify the endpoint when it matters; delivered does not mean read.
entries.example: The provider reports delivery to the receiving mail server.

entries.sense: Remove according to the product's actual deletion behavior.
entries.caution: Do not assume permanence, retention period, cascade or recovery.
entries.example: Delete the selected draft.

entries.sense: Detach or take away an item in context.
entries.caution: Removing a member or shortcut may leave the account or underlying file intact.
entries.example: Remove the shortcut from this folder.

entries.sense: Move into an archive state defined by the product.
entries.caution: Do not assume an archive is a backup or that it deletes content.
entries.example: Archive the conversation.

entries.sense: Return some specified state to a defined starting state.
entries.caution: Clarify what changes and what remains; reset alone is not a complete destructive-action label.
entries.example: Reset the filters.

entries.sense: Often marks an identifiable referent; it also has generic and conventional uses.
entries.caution: Do not add or remove it solely to reduce word count.
entries.example: Open the folder named Reports.

entries.sense: Can express a starting time or a reason.
entries.caution: Do not choose a temporal or causal rewrite without context.
entries.example: The service has been unavailable since noon.

entries.sense: Can mark simultaneous time or contrast.
entries.caution: Do not turn contrast into simultaneity or vice versa.
entries.example: The editor stayed open while the export ran.

entries.sense: Verb phrase for starting an authenticated session in a defined system.
entries.caution: A login can be a noun or modifier; preserve actual UI labels and identifiers.
entries.example: Log in with your account.

entries.sense: Its is possessive; it's can mean it is or it has.
entries.caution: Do not apply punctuation changes inside exact identifiers or quotations.
entries.example: The app keeps its settings. It's ready.
